title: Correctness before assuming success
text: A pipeline finishing without errors isn't the same as a pipeline producing the right output — the two get checked separately.

title: Reconciliation over conversion-and-hope
text: When a workflow moves from one system to another, the old and new outputs get compared before the old one is retired — not after.

title: Root cause over symptom fixes
text: RCA is a habit applied before a fix ships, not a postmortem written after — tracing a data mismatch back to the exact line of transformation logic that caused it.

title: Configuration over duplication
text: A recurring pipeline pattern becomes a reusable, config-driven framework — not a new copy-pasted script each time.

title: Failures should be visible, not guessed at
text: Validation and logging are part of the pipeline, not an afterthought bolted on when something breaks.

title: Avoid unnecessary complexity
text: Reach for an existing, proven pattern before introducing a new tool or dependency without a clear reason to.
